turns.text: I’m still engaged because, I’m thinking to myself, perhaps because this is not an area of expertise, of investment, for myself, I’m not fully grasping this. Perhaps I’m too old to grasp it. Perhaps this is, he’s not presenting it coherently and I should pay more attention.

turns.text:

turns.speaker: Jake
turns.text:

For Jake, he couldn’t make peace with the business’s mission. And for Phil, it was all about the bottom line.

turns.text: I don’t know where the revenue share is coming from. Where is the—how is the revenue being derived so that he can pay the influencers? And so it’s a numbers game. As an entrepreneur, all you can do is keep pounding the pavement, making those calls, and meeting with investors. Sometimes it takes a while. But nobody ever said this was going to be easy.
